Never granted to any runtime role: UPDATE/DELETE on users or seller_grants · UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE on audit_events · superuser, CREATEROLE, CREATEDB, BYPASSRLS.
Verified against PostgreSQL by tests/integration/test_m4_security.py (23 tables × 5 operations × 3 roles + every column-level UPDATE grant).

div.div: Approval integrity lives in the API role's single transaction: the reviewer must differ from the proposer and independently hold scope; stale revisions, duplicate approvals, and competing proposals return 409.
